public_rationale: The forecast was that agents would be a major focus of the AI field in 2025. OpenAI launched its Operator web agent in January 2025 and folded agent mode into ChatGPT in July 2025. The MIT-hosted 2025 AI Agent Index reports a substantial rise in attention to agents in 2025. It found more Google Scholar papers mentioning 'AI agent' or 'agentic AI' than in all prior years combined, and most of the 30 agents it tracks launched or got major updates in 2024–2025. The year has ended, and on a plain reading the forecast came true.
limitations: 'Major focus' is qualitative. The evidence shows prominence, not a ranking against other themes.
This was a low-risk forecast: agents were already a visible trend when the post was written.
